faq.q: What is Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht in GTA 6?
faq.a: Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht is a vehicle listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht?
faq.a: Most of it. Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Top speed, handling and stats and a gta 6 price are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Riva 86 Domino-inspired yacht be in the finished GTA 6?
